question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Consensus for FQ4 2026 (Sep quarter) ~$1.99-2.02 vs $1.85 a year ago; Apple beat in 8 of last 8 quarters, typically by 2-6%. Guidance: revenue +9-11% (~$112-114B), GM 47-48% incl ~1pt tariff refund benefit, supply constraints rising. Bottom-up: ~$113B rev x 47.5% GM - ~$17.8B opex, ~16.5% tax, ~14.6B diluted shares => ~$2.05-2.07. Downside tails: supply/memory cost or one-time tax charge; upside: bigger revenue beat. No prediction market found (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold). Report date Nov 2 per MacRumors, after scheduled resolution date, but same figure.

calls.reconciliation: All runs share the same facts (guidance, consensus ~$1.96-2.02, beat streak, FQ4'24 tax-charge precedent). Disputes: (1) report date Oct 29 vs Nov 2: immaterial, both are the first post-September report. (2) Run 1's bottom-up used ~$17.8B opex, contradicting the guided $19.1-19.4B cited by Runs 2 and 3; correcting it gives ~$1.96-1.98 pre-beat, so Run 1's $2.06 median is discounted. (3) Beat magnitude is a judgment call: historical Sept-quarter beats ~4-5%, but the FQ3'26 underlying beat was ~1% and supply headwinds rose. I take a ~3% beat on ~$1.98, giving a median of $2.04 and roughly Run 3's distribution. I carried Runs 2/3's reference class and dispersion forward. Tail: ~1% for a one-off GAAP charge. No market found per runs/harness; no web access this run.
